name: paprika-inc
description: Discuss and author repository-defined companies, clone safely, and bootstrap persistent local Codex project chats.

interface.longDescription: Paprika Inc MVP for local Codex. Discuss a generic roster with your chosen first staff chat, preview and write role contracts and a canonical ownership map when requested, clone an explicit Git repository/revision into an empty folder or validated matching checkout, and bootstrap the requested roles as persistent native project chats with read/report onboarding. A private sequential progress record supports status and verified reuse/resume. Missing saved projects require a one-time add-folder handoff; uncertain creation never blindly retries. One user-triggered bootstrap at a time: enforced singleton/race handling, transfer, background orchestration and self-adoption are future work. The kit has its own navy identity and three Inc skills; it does not install a duplicate Messenger product. It includes pinned Messenger source internally and can reference the same existing Paprika Service App in a private bound export. Installation, actual host/project evidence and service authentication are separately verified. Paprika Explain offers tailored explanations and a host-supported format picker, with a text-menu fallback.
defaultPrompt: Help me define my company and its roles.
Write the company files we discussed into my repository.
Bootstrap this Git company in my selected local Codex project.
